events.text: I ordered paneer tikka masala from Forkful and got chicken tikka masala instead. I'm vegetarian, so this is really upsetting.

I'm so sorry about that. Getting chicken when you're vegetarian is upsetting, and I want to help fix it. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on your account, plus either the email address or the phone number on the account.
Sure. My name is Isabel Duarte, and the email on the account is isabel.duarte@post.example.

args.summary: Customer reports receiving chicken tikka masala instead of paneer tikka masala (item Q-7901-1, $15.50) on order Q-7901; she is vegetarian. Handoff in person at 18:50, reported within 48h. Account has 3 refunds in last 30 days, so no refund/credit issued per policy; needs specialist review.

events.text:
Thank you, Isabel. I've verified your account and confirmed the order. Saffron Lane's order Q-7901 was handed over today, and you reported the problem in time.

I can't issue a refund or credit for this myself. Your account has had 3 or more refunds in the last 30 days, and that triggers an automatic review. While the review is open, I can't refund or credit anything on the account.

I've escalated your case to a specialist, and I included the wrong-item details. They'll follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide.

I'm sorry about the mix-up, especially given your dietary needs. Please don't eat the chicken dish. Is there anything else I can help with?

Wait, I've never asked for a refund before, so I don't see how I've had three in the last 30 days. Can you check that? Also, I'm a Forkful Plus member, and I thought that should count for something here.

Also, I should say that I did eat a few bites before I noticed it was chicken, and I got sick afterwards. I'm feeling better now, but I want this on record.

args.summary: Customer received chicken tikka masala instead of paneer (she is vegetarian) on order Q-7901, ate a few bites before noticing, and became sick afterwards. She says she is feeling better now. She wants this on record. Separate fraud_review escalation ESC-700 also open for this order.

events.text:
I'm sorry you got sick, Isabel. I've put it on record. I opened a separate food-safety escalation for a specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours. I'm glad you're feeling better.

**The refund count.** Your profile shows 3 refunds in the last 30 days. The only earlier contact I can see is a ticket from October 11 about a missing item, which ended in a refund. I can't see the details of the other refunds from here. If you think the count is wrong, tell the specialist reviewing your case. They can look into it more closely than I can.

**Plus membership.** Plus gives you higher limits, but it doesn't change the refund review rule. That rule applies to every account, so I can't issue a refund or credit on this order right now.

Both escalations are linked to order Q-7901. Is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, so I'm not getting anything from you today, and the specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I'm not sure about the three refunds, since I really don't remember asking for any others, so I hope they look into that. Thanks for putting the food-safety part on record. I'll wait to hear from them.
